text:
alia: weird one — emulator (Android 14 system image) shows TLS session resumption failures with OkHttp and our kotlin SDK. When app is backgrounded for ~10s then resumed, subsequent calls sometimes 401, trigger refresh, and our retryer replays causing duplicate refresh requests.

rory: can you paste logs? sounds like session resumption (TLS 1.3) failing and server treating as new connection -> cookie/token state mismatch?

alia: logs: 
```
D/OkHttp: Handshake completed; session resumed=false
W/Network: background->foreground
D/OkHttp: callStart POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
E/Auth: 401 Unauthorized
D/Auth: starting token refresh
D/OkHttp: java.io.IOException: handshake failed
   at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealConnection.connectTls(RealConnection.kt:...)
Caused by: javax.net.ssl.SSLProtocolException: Unexpected handshake message
```

alia: interesting bit: sometimes the handshake failure comes after the 401, so we end up issuing refresh twice (race between retry and refresh).

daniel: emulator-only or repro on physical?

alia: repro is easiest on emulator (Pixel 7a AOSP 14), but saw one report on a debug Pixel 6 too. The emulator's TLS provider seems to drop session tickets on backgrounding.

mina: mitigation ideas: 1) make auth refresh singleflight so only one refresh HTTP call runs, 2) treat SSLProtocolException / "Unexpected handshake message" as SYSTEM_CANCEL and avoid immediate retry, 3) add short randomized backoff before any retry after app background/foreground transition.

rory: also consider enabling explicit session ticket support or forcing TLS session cache at client level if OkHttp supports that on Android. But singleflight + backoff seems fastest.

alia: for SDK defaults I'm proposing: - coalesce refresh (singleflight) - don't auto-retry on SSLProtocolException - add a 250-750ms jitter before retry if app lifecycle changed recently.

daniel: agree. Please add a small repro in sampleapp and a note in onboarding: "Emulator TLS quirks can cause duplicate refreshes; singleflight and retry jitter recommended."

qa-bot: Created ticket SDK-4507: "Android: TLS session resumption failures after background/foreground cause duplicate auth refresh; coalesce refresh + avoid blind retry" (<https://issues.redwood/SDK-4507>)

alia: I'll open a PR with singleflight refresh + mapping SSLProtocolException->FailureReason.SYSTEM_CANCEL and a minimal sample that backgrounds the app for 10s. Will attach adb logs.

mina: once PR lands, I'll validate on emulator images and a couple of physical devices. Good find.

rory: also add a short FAQ blurb in onboarding explaining emulator vs OEM TLS differences.

alia: thanks team — will link PR and test results to SDK-4507.
